# Convert the 'date' column to datetime and extract the year 2021 only.
# Then, group by month and count the number of campaigns.
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
df_2021 = df[df['date'].dt.year == 2021]
monthly_campaigns = df_2021.groupby(df_2021['date'].dt.to_period('M')).size().reset_index(name='campaign_count')
monthly_campaigns['date'] = monthly_campaigns['date'].dt.to_timestamp()
result = monthly_campaigns

import plotly.express as px

# Create a line chart
fig = px.line(
    result, 
    x='date', 
    y='campaign_count', 
    title='Total Number of Campaigns per Month in 2021',
    labels={'date': 'Month', 'campaign_count': 'Number of Campaigns'},
    markers=True
)

# Customize the layout
fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title='Month',
    yaxis_title='Number of Campaigns',
    xaxis_tickformat='%b %Y',
    hovermode='x unified'
)

# Save the plot
fig.write_html(filepath)
